name: ShenZhen Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material Co., Ltd. researches, develops, makes and sells polymer materials modified by radiation, along with electronic and electrical materials. Products include electronic goods, detachable cable accessories, foam materials, power series products, cables and new energy products. Founded in 1998, it is headquartered in Shenzhen.
